parse.title: The Eyes of Glouphrie
parse.wikitext:
==Details==
{{Quest details
|description = After you foiled a plan to destroy the Grand Tree things have been quiet in the gnome world. Brimstail has found a strange machine, though, built by [[Oaknock]] the Engineer during the Gnomes' Golden Age. What does the weird device do? Why on Gielinor was it built? If you agree to help this bookworm gnome get this confusing device working, you will learn a little about gnome magicks, gnome history, and you will start to uncover a new threat (or is it an old one?) to gnome security - a threat that is a lot harder to see ...
|start = Talk to [[Brimstail]] in his [[Brimstail's cave|cave]] south-west side of the [[Tree Gnome Stronghold]], directly west of the bank near the [[Stronghold Slayer Cave]].
|startmap = 2406,9817
|difficulty = Intermediate
|length = Medium
|requirements = *Completed [[The Grand Tree]] quest
*{{SCP|Construction|5|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} {{Questreqstart|}}
*{{SCP|Magic|46|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} {{Questreqstart|no}}
|items = *[[Bucket of sap]] (If you do not have one, you can use a [[knife]] on any [[Tree#Single canopy|tree]] that looks pointy (evergreen shaped trees) with a [[bucket]] in your inventory)
*[[Mud rune]]
*[[Maple logs]]
*[[Oak logs]]
*[[Hammer]]
*[[Saw]]
*[[Pestle and mortar]]
|recommended = *Several free inventory slots (about 8) to solve the puzzles more easily
*Fast travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold ([[Balloon Transport System]], [[gnome glider]], [[Spirit Tree]] or [[Slayer ring]] to the Slayer Cave to directly reach the Stronghold -- alternatively, use a [[necklace of passage]] to the Outpost and walk north)
*Fast travel to Hazelmere ([[Fairy rings]] to {{Fairycode|cls}}, or [[Watchtower teleport|Watchtower]] or [[Nightmare Zone]] [[minigame]] teleport and walk east if you have no access to fairy rings)
**[[Slayer ring]] to the Slayer Dungeon or a [[necklace of passage]] to the Wizards' Tower for easy access to fairy rings
|kills = 6 x [[Evil creature]] that each have 1 HP
|ironman = *A method to obtain [[mud runes]]:
**{{SCP|Runecraft|13|link=yes}} to craft them
**As a reward from the [[Mage Training Arena]] with {{SCP|Magic|33|link=yes}}
**1/100 drop from [[essence implings]] with {{SCP|Hunter|42|link=yes}}
*A method to obtain [[maple logs]]:
**{{SCP|Woodcutting|45|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} to cut [[maple trees]]
**Guaranteed from the [[Managing Miscellania]] activity (requires {{SCP|Quest|Throne of Miscellania}})
**{{SCP|Firemaking|50|link=yes}} {{Boostable|No}}  for maple logs from the [[Wintertodt]] [[Reward Cart]] (drop chance based on {{SCP|Woodcutting}} level).
**Completing [[Hunters' Rumours]] with {{SCP|Hunter|46|link=yes}} {{Boostable|no}} to receive [[Hunters' loot sack]] (drop chance based on {{SCP|Woodcutting}} level)
**Using [[Serum 208]] for a 1/128 drop of maple logs from curing [[Afflicted]] (requires {{SCP|Quest|Shades of Mort'ton}}).
*A method to obtain [[oak logs]]:
**{{SCP|Woodcutting|15|link=yes}} to chop [[oak trees]]
**1/17.2 drop from sorting [[small salvage]] with {{SCP|Sailing|15|link=yes}}, 1/11.6 from [[fishy salvage]] with {{SCP|Sailing|26|link=yes}}, 1/5.68 from [[barracuda salvage]] with {{SCP|Sailing|35|link=yes}}
**1/16.2 drop from [[Brutus]] ({{SCP|Combat|30}}), requiring completion of {{SCP|Quest|The Ides of Milk}}
[[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] [[Magic glue]] can be made before starting the quest by grinding the [[mud rune]] with the [[pestle and mortar]] and using it on a [[bucket of sap]], saving inventory space.
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}
